Market Analysis
In 1Q2026, Thailand’s car production increased by 3.46% YoY, indicating a
gradual recovery in the automotive sector supported by both emerging
and traditional segments.
Growth during the period was underpinned by the continued expansion of
electrified vehicles (xEV), particularly BEV (+11.98% YoY) and HEV (+6.74%
YoY), reflecting increasing product diversification and evolving consumer
preferences. At the same time, Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) vehicles
remain a core component of the industry, accounting for a significant
production base, although output moderated slightly by 4.46% YoY in line
with market dynamics.
